name: type-rush-monorepo
description: Type Rush - Modern Real-Time Typing Competition Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:student" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build:student: cd student-portal && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:admin: cd admin-portal && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:student && npm run build:admin
